        cell.value = None

vba_lines = [
    "Sub DeleteBlankRowsInFtoM()",
    "    Dim ws As Worksheet",
    "    Dim i As Long",
    "    Dim rng As Range",
    "",
    "    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(\"Sheet4\")",
    "",
    "    Application.ScreenUpdating = False",
    "",
    "    'Work from the bottom up so deleted rows do not affect rows still to be checked.",
    "    For i = 83 To 14 Step -1",
    "        Set rng = ws.Range(\"F\" & i & \":M\" & i)",
    "        If Application.WorksheetFunction.CountA(rng) = 0 Then",
    "            rng.EntireRow.Delete",
    "        End If",
    "    Next i",
    "",
    "    Application.ScreenUpdating = True",
    "End Sub",
    "",
    "'Notes:",
    "'Use \"F\" & i & \":M\" & i to build the row range; do not put the variables inside quotes.",
    "'There is no need to ClearContents before deleting the row.",
    "'If you collect rows in a variable and then clear/delete them, test that the variable is not Nothing first,",
    "'because when every cell is blank the special-cells/clear step can otherwise be called on an invalid range.",
    "'Example guard: If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.EntireRow.Delete",
]

start_row = 9
for idx, line in enumerate(vba_lines, start=start_row):

# Verification: reopen and print the populated answer cells within E9:M83.

    if any(v is not None for v in vals):
        print(r, vals)
